descriptions.d24l_audio_bars_802a6b30: Prepares the 'FE.AudioBar' mesh: when its entry count (0x80171f90) is not 2, reserves two entries and writes their UV and position quads, flipping the V coordinates against 1.0; then loads eight bar instances into +276.. with resource type byte(+35)+29, stores byte value 1 on each and attaches them to the panel +224, and finishes with 0x802a64a8.
